## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Finland recorded 674K actual service units in 2025, -10.0% compared to 2024 (749K).

- Actual 2025 service units were -16.9% below the plan (811K).

- Actual 2025 service units are -33.3% below the actual 2019 level (1,011K).
